# order<TAB>slug<TAB>kind<TAB>title<TAB>ERE matched against the commit subject; the first matching line owns the commit.
# kind patch: a change shipped as a net diff, clamcove-<version>-<position>-<slug>.patch (merged with the changes it cannot be split from);
# kind none: CI under .github, not shipped; kind paths: one line, the space-separated paths of tests, test inputs, fuzz targets, tooling
# and docs that every change edits, shipped as the last patch for all changes together. Lines are tried in file order, so a narrower
# regex goes before a wider one; the order column names the change and sorts the series before merging.
# A commit between the upstream tag and the release tag that matches no line fails the release job.
